conditions: 18 frozen 1440x900 images in three views; recorded scene, material, transform and per-variant light/SSAO invariants passed. Independent visual review covered front and portrait; root also inspected right30.
observations: Reducing the carried light is the main visible improvement: less orange under-light on the face and less pale glare on the coat, while the lantern and nearby ground still read warm.
Neutral face fill adds a smaller reduction in yellow tint without removing face readability.
Head-no-cast, main-no-shadows and SSAO-off did not remove the broad cheek gray region in the tested pose; no claim that all possible shadow or AO defects are excluded.
Nose/mouth relief, flat eye layers, fixed gaze, hair grooves and remaining side-cheek shading still limit visual quality.

normalMode.scope: Short Iris Xe 1440x900 samples; not sustained minimum FPS or isolated performance improvement.

stableRelease: v13 retained; no v14 WebGL or release ZIP
next: Review Blender nose/mouth/cheek volume candidate separately before importing.
